section: Oregon corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate Activity Tax (CAT)
value: $250 plus 0.57% of taxable Oregon commercial activity over $1 million
note: Gross-receipts tax on all business forms; a 35% subtraction for certain expenses applies. Only businesses above $1 million owe it.
source_title: Oregon Department of Revenue: Corporate Activity Tax

label: Levied by
value: Local taxing districts such as cities, counties, school districts, community colleges, fire districts and ports
note: The county assessor verifies each district's rate and the county tax collector collects and distributes the tax.
source_title: Oregon Secretary of State, Oregon Blue Book: Finance and Taxes

label: State oversight
value: Oregon Department of Revenue, Property Tax program

label: Rate limits (Measure 5)
value: Non-school taxes up to $10 per $1,000 and school taxes up to $5 per $1,000 of real market value
note: Constitutional limits from 1990; voter-approved bonds sit outside them.
source_title: Oregon Secretary of State, Oregon Blue Book: Finance and Taxes

label: Assessed value growth cap (Measure 50)
note: Assessed value may grow at most 3% a year until it reaches real market value; districts have fixed permanent rates.
source_title: Oregon Secretary of State, Oregon Blue Book: Finance and Taxes

section: Oregon real estate transfer tax: figures under review
label: State real estate transfer tax

note: Article IX, section 15 (Measure 79, 2012) bars state and local transfer taxes except those operative on December 31, 2009.
source_title: Oregon State Legislature: Oregon Constitution, Article IX, section 15
